faults.activation: An old call is observed, reconnect changes actor and work, then callback dispatch overwrites its original lease binding.
faults.activation_evidence: fault_activated is true and the new work contains OLD_WORK_CALLBACK attributed to new-actor
faults.observable_violation: A callback denied to old-actor records evidence using replacement authority.
faults.passing_control: Same host fault with no replacement never activates; original actor denial and empty work evidence hold.

faults.activation: An effect increments a native counter, reconnect occurs while its response is held, then its completed host result is classified not_started.
faults.activation_evidence: fault_activated is true, host has a completed effect, application operation is failed and a new send increments the counter to two
faults.observable_violation: False certainty removes the recovery fence and permits another effect.
faults.passing_control: Same host fault without replacement never activates; completion is truthful and a subsequent send is legitimate.

attribution: Each scenario and activation check completes before the target assertion is expected to raise. Setup exceptions propagate outside that handler; only the named AssertionError earns detection. Faulty subjects remain faulty.
